messages:
penny: FYI EdgeShift (SI) wants a "hands-on" session showing LangChain + LlamaIndex pipelines routed through Redwood Gateway into their orchestrator, with a Sigma edge box attached. They want a sandbox demo customers can run themselves.

omar: Key constraints: no long-lived creds, exportable audit trail, and a reproducible prompt bundle. We should use ephemeral OIDC clients + short-lived tokens and rotate keys post-demo.

sasha: Agree. Suggest Private sandbox VPC for isolation. For reproducibility, pin model versions and disable KV prefix caching during the demo. We'll include a fixed prompt set and seed.

ops-bot: note: created branch partnerships/edgeshift-demo and scheduled provision job (eta: 45m)

opmar: @sasha can you outline the token flow we'll show? I'll add an appendix to the runbook.

sasha: Token flow (summary): 1) user auth via PKCE -> 2) exchange for 3min JWT scoped to demo:audience -> 3) Redwood issues request_id header; logs stream to s3-demo-retention. Snippet to include in runbook: ```POST /oauth/token``` -> { "access_token": "...", "expires_in": 180 }

penny: Legal said Sigma will only allow perf numbers if NDA + benchmark disclosure are signed. We'll keep perf visuals blurred unless signed.

legal: We need partner contacts and an explicit list of what metrics Sigma wants to show. I'll send NDA + benchmark addendum. Don't publish numbers until signed.

omar: Infra note: provisioned a 2xA10G Dedicated pool for the demo; can switch to Private if we need tighter network controls. I set autoscale min=0 max=4.

sasha: Can CI add a smoke test that: 1) verifies token rotation, 2) checks audit log entries in S3, 3) asserts HMAC on webhook callbacks? That would be super helpful for partners to run locally.

ops-bot: ci: smoke-tests/edgeshift-token-rotation queued

penny: Timeline: EdgeShift asked for Wed 10am CET. Can we do internal dry run Tue 8am PT?

omar: Tue 8am PT internal dry run works. I'll reserve the workspace and drop creds into Vault with a demo read-only role.

sasha: I'll draft the runbook (2 pages: onboarding, token-exchange, smoke-tests, rollback) and include a terraform snippet for route policy: ```resource "redwood_route" "demo" { default_model = "redwood/llama-2-qlo" canary_percent = 5 }```

penny: Marketing wants a "developer showcase" spin; we'll avoid marketplace listing initially. Proposed embargo: 14 days post sign-off unless partners agree.

legal: Acknowledged. I'll circulate NDA + embargo clause. Also add a note about not bundling Sigma perf numbers in public assets until the addendum is returned.

ops-bot: smoke-tests/edgeshift-token-rotation started (running)

omar: Follow-ups: sasha -> runbook PR by EOD; omar -> vault creds + workspace by Tue 6am PT; penny -> send NDA + dry-run invite to EdgeShift.

sasha: ACK. I'll include a minimal prompt set and pytest smoke test that asserts deterministic outputs with disabled caching.

penny: Thanks team. Ping me if blocked. :rocket:
